notes.title: Game Update v5.0.1
notes.content: We've just updated the game to the latest version of the HexWar Engine. This includes various bug fixes and performance improvements!

notes.title: Wars of the Roses version 2.0.1 update
notes.content: Fix: Some sound effects not playing following the last update.

notes.title: Wars of the Roses Version 2.0.0 Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Add: Map labels to most scenarios.
[*] Change: Improved A.I. opponent.
[*] Change: Improved game logic for advance after combat. Unit will more often advance after combat if the target hex has been vacated.
[*] Change: Mission design credits.
[*] Change: Source material credits.
[*] Fix: An issue with image scaling on older Apple iOS devices.
[*] Fix: Invalid font selection on some buttons on some platforms.
[*] Fix: Some projectile animations not displaying.
[*] Fix: Some screen layout issues.
[*] Update: Campaign map graphics. It is now clearer which campaigns have been completed.
[/list]
